chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) regarding the words of God, Mighty and Majestic:
'And let not the witnesses refuse when they are summoned' [2:282].
So he said: 'When a man summons you to testify for him regarding a debt or a right, it is not befitting for you to hold back from it.'

key_terms.الشُّهَدَاء: Witnesses; those summoned to bear witness to legal or financial transactions
key_terms.تَقَاعَسَ: To balk, to hold back, to be reluctant or slow to respond when called upon
key_terms.حَقّ: Right; a legal or moral entitlement or claim
key_terms.دَيْن: Debt; a financial obligation owed by one party to another

ai.seo_question: Are witnesses obligated to respond when summoned to testify in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), most likely Imam al-Ridha, provides a practical interpretation of Quran 2:282 which commands that witnesses not refuse when summoned to testify. The Imam clarifies the scope of this obligation: when a person calls upon you specifically to testify on his behalf concerning a financial debt or a legal right, it is improper for you to hesitate or refuse. This ruling establishes the religious duty of responding to a summons for testimony in matters of financial transactions, reflecting the Quranic emphasis on establishing justice through reliable witnesses.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassanasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [2:282]
and the witnesses should not refuse when they are summoned.
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When the man summons you in order to testify for him, or a right, it is not befitting for you that you balk from it’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Muhammad ibn al- Fudayl who has narrated the following: “This is about the meaning of the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious. ‘. . .
the witnesses must not refuse to testify when they are summoned to testify,’ [2:282]
abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al- Salam, has said, ‘When the man calls you to testify for him about a loan or a right, it is not proper for you to refuse and step back to delay.’”
